question_text: Explain how an operating system manages access by two running programs to the same printer.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: The OS uses the printer driver to communicate with the device. It queues or schedules requests so programs share the printer in an orderly way, preventing their output from being interleaved incorrectly.
